# [TASK] Implement API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway)

## Task
Spring Cloud Gateway as the single entry point for client requests — routes to every backend service, with JWT auth, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and CORS.

## Parent Story
Parent: #84

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Gateway starts on port 8080 and routes to all backend services
- [x] JWT authentication filter and CORS configured
- [x] Redis-backed rate limiting and a Resilience4j circuit breaker working
- [x] Registered with Eureka for service discovery
- [x] Unit + integration tests passing, Dockerfile builds

## Estimate
**Hours:** 8

## Notes
Implemented 2025-11-15/16 — module scaffolded in `184d2f2`, routing/JWT/rate-limiting/circuit-breaker landed in `0fe3f1f` and `e5e41c7`. The gateway has grown well past this original slice since (TMDB facade/auth proxy routes, further DDoS hardening) — out of scope for this Task.
